symptom: CE0463 "The definition of this widget has changed" on every Marketplace Calendar (2.6.1, 11.12.5) written by mxcli, visible to a plain `mx check` but not to `mxcli docker check`, which runs update-widgets on a temporary copy first. The only difference from an update-widgets copy: the toolbarItems property (type="object" isList="true") stored ValueType.ObjectType null (mendixlabs/mxcli#1632).
cause: The .mpk parser read an object property's sub-properties only from `<properties><propertyGroup>`; the Calendar lists them directly under `<properties>`, each with a `<category>` element. PropertyDef.Children stayed empty, so GenerateFromMPK (the Calendar has no embedded template) wrote no nested WidgetObjectType.
file: modelsdk/widgets/mpk/mpk.go (xmlProperty.NestedDirectProps and Category, nestedGroups, collectNestedProperties takes a direct child's own <category>); tests modelsdk/widgets/mpk/objectdirect_test.go, modelsdk/widgets/objectdirect_test.go; example mdl-examples/bug-tests/1632-calendar-toolbaritems-definition.mdl
insight: The second .mpk parser, sdk/widgets/mpk (widget init, catalog, widget docs), already read both shapes and named PopupMenu basicItems and Maps markers as examples of the direct one; modelsdk/widgets/mpk had only the grouped one. PopupMenu and Maps never showed it because they have embedded templates, whose nested ObjectType comes from the template rather than the parser. When two parsers of one format exist, diff their xml struct tags first. Checking a generated widget against `mx update-widgets` on a copy, ids stripped, gives the exact field; `mxcli docker check` cannot, because it runs that same update before checking.
